test.create_query: CREATE TABLE moved_prewhere_fact (id UInt64, a UInt32, b UInt32, c UInt32, d UInt32, e UInt32, f UInt32, v Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE moved_prewhere_dim (id UInt32, name String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO moved_prewhere_fact SELECT number, number % 300000, (number * 7) % 300000, (number * 13) % 300000, (number * 17) % 300000, (number * 19) % 300000, (number * 23) % 300000, number % 100 FROM numbers(2000000)
INSERT INTO moved_prewhere_dim SELECT number, concat('name_', toString(cityHash64(number))) FROM numbers(300000)
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(v) FROM moved_prewhere_fact WHERE a IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%11%') AND b IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%12%') AND c IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%13%') AND d IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%14%') AND e IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%15%') AND f IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%16%') AND a IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%1%') AND b IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%2%') AND c IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%3%') AND d IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%4%') AND e IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%5%') AND f IN (SELECT id FROM moved_prewhere_dim WHERE name LIKE '%6%')
